Switzerland / CITY EDIT

Where to Stay in Zurich

Choose a Zurich base around your arrival route, Grossmünster and the pace of your weekend.

By Travelber Editorial · Updated 19 October 2026

IN THIS GUIDE

Near your main sightseeing areaNear your arrival connectionA quieter local baseBefore reserving a roomOfficial sources
← Switzerland overview

Near your main sightseeing area

Compare addresses near Grossmünster if it is the focus of your break. Check walking directions to Kunsthaus Zürich before assuming both are convenient from the same base. Look at the exact street, lift access and recent property information.

Near your arrival connection

A base near your arrival station can suit a late arrival or early departure. Compare the complete route to your priority sights in Zurich. A station district is not automatically the quietest or most atmospheric place to stay.

A quieter local base

A residential location can suit a slower break when transport is convenient. Check the evening service, nearby dining options and the distance from the final stop to your door. Compare total cost after adding local transport.

Before reserving a room

  • Check all compulsory charges and the cancellation deadline.
  • Confirm late check-in and luggage storage directly.
  • Verify step-free access for the specific room and building.
  • Read current details about street noise and building works.

This guide compares location choices; it does not endorse individual hotels or claim availability.
